# SeleniumIQ — Screenshot Plan

## Screenshots

### 1. AI Locator Generation
**Title:** Generate smart locators with stability scores
**Capture:** The "Generate AI Locator" action result showing multiple locator strategies (ID, CSS, XPath, data-testid) ranked by stability score with the recommended option highlighted.

### 2. Self-Healing in Action
**Title:** Broken locators repaired automatically
**Capture:** An editor notification showing a broken locator detected with the self-healing suggestion: original locator crossed out, new locator proposed, with "Accept" and "Dismiss" buttons.

### 3. Flakiness Prediction Dashboard
**Title:** Predict flaky tests before they fail
**Capture:** The SeleniumIQ tool window showing a list of tests with flakiness risk scores, color-coded health metrics, and the most common risk factors.

### 4. Code Inspections
**Title:** Detect brittle patterns in the editor
**Capture:** A Java test file showing inline warnings: a Thread.sleep call highlighted with "Replace with WebDriverWait" quick-fix, and a brittle XPath locator with stability warning.

### 5. Page Object Generator
**Title:** Auto-generate Page Object classes
**Capture:** The Page Object generator dialog showing a web page URL input, detected elements list, and the generated Java class preview with PageFactory annotations.

### 6. Time-Travel Debugging
**Title:** Replay test executions step by step
**Capture:** The time-travel debugging view showing a timeline of test steps, the DOM snapshot at the selected step, and the element being interacted with highlighted.

### 7. Visual Regression Results
**Title:** Spot visual changes with pixel-perfect comparison
**Capture:** The visual regression report showing a baseline screenshot, current screenshot, and diff overlay with changed regions highlighted in red.

### 8. Cloud Platform Setup
**Title:** One-click cloud testing configuration
**Capture:** The cloud platform setup dialog showing BrowserStack/Sauce Labs selection, credentials input, and generated WebDriver configuration preview.

## Video Demo Outline (55 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Show plugin name with "AI-Powered Test Automation" tagline |
| 5-15s | Locators | Generate an AI locator for a web element, show stability scores |
| 15-25s | Self-Heal | Show a broken locator detected and healed automatically |
| 25-35s | Inspections | Highlight a Thread.sleep, apply quick-fix to replace with WebDriverWait |
| 35-45s | Flakiness | Open the dashboard, show predicted flaky tests with risk scores |
| 45-53s | Time-Travel | Replay a failed test with DOM snapshots |
| 53-55s | CTA | "Install SeleniumIQ — AI-powered Selenium testing" |
